coordinateFrame: Equatorial J2000, raDeg and decDeg in degrees. All distances light-years. No proper motion propagation.

provenance.name: HYG 4.1, David Nash / Astronexus
provenance.changes: Union of nearest30 finite-distance stars, brightest500 by apparent V, all HYG proper names and matched current IAU names. Invalid distances preserved as unknown; no sentinel positions.

provenance.name: OpenNGC, Mattia Verga and contributors
provenance.changes: All132 Common names rows plus M101. Coordinates and angular extents from OpenNGC; distances from per-object literature/SIMBAD records, never a generic nearby Hubble-law estimate.

provenance.name: ATNF Pulsar Catalogue 2.9.0, Manchester et al. 2005 AJ129 1993
provenance.citation: Manchester, R.N., Hobbs, G.B., Teoh, A. & Hobbs, M. (2005), AJ 129, 1993–2006. DOI:10.1086/428488
provenance.changes: Original Vela and Crab pulsar landmarks plus named Geminga distance retained; arbitrary20-nearest pulsar filler removed.

provenance.name: SIMBAD / CDS Strasbourg
provenance.query: J2000 positions of original named objects via sim-tap/sync.
provenance.acknowledgement: This research has made use of the SIMBAD database, operated at CDS, Strasbourg, France.

provenance.name: IAU WGSN Catalog of Star Names
provenance.license: Names public domain; etymology text not redistributed.

provenance.name: SIMBAD named-star astrometry
provenance.license: ODbL for SIMBAD data subset; names public domain
provenance.changes: Identity lookup and positive parallax inversion only when relative error <=20%; no missing distance substitution.
provenance.citation: Wenger et al. 2000 A&AS143,9. CDS Strasbourg.

provenance.name: SIMBAD named deep-sky distances
provenance.license: ODbL for distance subset; see per-object reference
provenance.changes: Traceable non-redshift distance selections. Unresolved objects remain in atlas without invented physical positions.

selection.brightness: Apparent Johnson V magnitude as seen from Earth; smaller number is brighter; not absolute luminosity.
selection.namedScope: All current IAU WGSN CSN names plus HYG traditional proper names and curated named deep-sky landmarks. Not every informal name ever used.
selection.unresolvedDistances: Objects remain searchable but not navigable. HYG sentinel100000pc is never treated as a physical distance.
selection.namedDeepSky: All OpenNGC Common names (132 rows) plus familiar M101; original famous landmarks retained; arbitrary nearest ATNF and numbered-galaxy filler removed.

curatedCosmicLandmarks.references: Individual source URLs, position assumptions, extent definitions and candidate status retained per record.
curatedCosmicLandmarks.distance: Present-epoch comoving distance integrated from redshift in common flat LCDM H0=70, OmegaM=0.3, OmegaLambda=0.7; radiation neglected. Light-travel time is separately integrated, never used as distance.
curatedCosmicLandmarks.nearbyVoid: Local Void anchor: Cosmicflows-3 Lacerta-2.4 SG XYZ=(22,-9,22) Mpc, transformed using the Lahav/de Vaucouleurs supergalactic basis.
curatedCosmicLandmarks.display: Illustrative contours; widths or central directions without measured footprints are explicitly identified. No decorative filler.
